model: transient heat conduction in a homogeneous 1D bar with constant properties: rho*cp*dT/dt = k*d2T/dx2, alpha = k/(rho*cp)
method: explicit finite differences (FTCS) on a uniform mesh; insulated ends by a mirror node; stable for Fourier number alpha*dt/dx^2 <= 1/2
scope: verification of a 1D bar model; moving heat sources and 2D/3D welding simulation are outside this version

boundaries.at_initial_time: a prescribed temperature replaces the initial value of its end node at t = 0

discretization.end_time_rule: full steps of time_step, then one shorter step ending exactly at end_time when it falls between steps

sampling.rule: the initial state, every n-th step and always the final state

completeness: this file is written last, after the CSV is complete; an export without it is incomplete
